answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The nebula is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lantern. The echo of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
